Title: Show HN: I built a game where you are an LLM's subagent
![Image 1](https://news.ycombinator.com/s.gif)[](https://news.ycombinator.com/vote?id=50601985&how=up&goto=item%3Fid%3D50599762#50601985)Looks pretty good and is quite fun to play, but for some reason the manager always told me the exact commands to achieve the tasks instead of just letting me do them by myself. I couldn't tell whether there was a specific option to take on the challenge on my own, as the demo on GitHub showcases.
![
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这款 Show HN 游戏让你扮演 LLM 的 subagent，有玩家反馈 manager 总直接给出完成任务的具体命令，作者随后在开始界面加入 No command hints 选项，只说明结果要求，解法需自己摸索。

en.reason: A Show HN game casts you as an LLM's subagent, and after a player noted the manager always handed over exact commands, the author added a "No command hints" start-screen option that states only the required outcome.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇值得读，因为 mod_wsgi 作者 Graham Dumpleton 用 AI 辅助 Rust 开发 Muru，为 ASGI/WSGI Python 应用提供开发与生产服务器，并连续三周公开极详细记录，坦言判断哪里不够好仍靠二十年踩坑经验。

en.reason: Graham Dumpleton, who started mod_wsgi 20 years ago, built Muru, an AI-assisted Rust server for ASGI and WSGI Python apps, with three weeks of detailed public logs on what still falls short.
